full_details: At nine you rehearsed Richard the Third from the rolls. The three cues from Friday were left as they were. The comedy was not in that room. At the lodging, before dinner, you finished the spring note and the winter note and shut the door on one prose line. You kept the plain refusal. At two you played Richard the Third. The Rose bill was Tasso. You did not go. After the play Garnish found a lady called Katharine on one leaf and Rosaline on the next, with the same lover, and you chose. Heminges wrote one dull line: Navarre ended this day. Pope asked whether a reward was the point. You kept the refusal. No parts were given out.
one_sentence: You shut the comedy on one prose line before dinner, played Richard the Third at two, and put forty-odd leaves into Garnish's hands.
title: Shut the comedy and gave Garnish the book
